items.question: Sau khi bơm, mực nước bể tưới cao hơn vạch chuẩn bao nhiêu cm (ghi số âm nếu vẫn thấp hơn)?

items.gloss_en: The west tank is at the {T} cm mark. The greenhouse irrigation tank is now at the {A} cm mark, its reference mark is at {B} cm. Tonight the pump will raise the irrigation tank's water by {C} cm. After pumping, how many cm above the reference mark is the water (negative if still below)?

items.rule_gloss: A seedlings over B rows gives plants per row; times C fruit each; actual minus target D (may be negative).
